convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'VortexIndicator' which is a custom indicator not in the built-in set. Also depends on external #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> for position management functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). Both require manual reimplementation in Python.

other_exits: Long position closed when VI- crosses above VI+ (signal reversal exit enabled by BuyPosClose=true)
Short position closed when VI+ crosses above VI- (signal reversal exit enabled by SellPosClose=true)

params.description: MM=-0.1 means 0.1 fixed lot (negative value convention); positive values would mean share of deposit

position_sizing.conditional_logic: if MM < 0 then fixed lot size = abs(MM); else deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: Signal detection uses 2-bar lookback: current bar (index SignalBar=1) and previous bar (index SignalBar+1=2) from CopyBuffer. Entry triggers on crossover: UpValue[1]>DnValue[1] (prior bar VI+ > VI-) AND UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0] (current bar VI+ was below or equal VI-, confirming the crossover just occurred). Similarly for short. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the last completed bar, not the forming bar. Recount flag ensures data is re-read if CopyBuffer fails. CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh enforces once-per-bar execution. LoadHistory ensures bar data availability. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up global variables on deinit. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs act as permission gates for each direction.
python_conversion_notes: 1) VortexIndicator must be reimplemented in Python — it computes VI+ and VI- from true range and directional movement over VI_Length periods. Formula: VM+ = |High[i] - Low[i-1]|, VM- = |Low[i] - Low[i-1]|, TR = max(|High-Low|, |High-Close[i-1]|, |Low-Close[i-1]|), then VI+ = SMA(VM+, period) / SMA(TR, period), VI- = SMA(VM-, period) / SMA(TR, period). 2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, etc.) can be replaced with simple market order logic — they are wrappers around OrderSend with position checking, lot sizing from MM parameter, and SL/TP placement. 3) The crossover detection uses a 2-element buffer comparison pattern: buffer[1] vs buffer[0] where [1] is the older bar. 4) SignalBar=1 means always read from the last closed bar; Recount flag handles data readiness. 5) MM=-0.1 means fixed 0.1 lot; positive values would be deposit fraction.
